issues.quote: Herrgott, the regulator on the wall had stopped. And he had his repeater in his hand.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no reading for the atelier regulator or the master's repeater, and no time of death or duration.
issues.misreading: A stopped wall clock and a repeater watch in hand are time-related details the sheet does not supply. A solver could read the stopped regulator as fixing when the death happened, or read the repeater as giving a reading that was never stated, and build a timeline on it.
